title: Local transcript
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive tester for Boolean-valued functions on a disjoint union of an input domain of size $n$ and a proof domain of size $\text{proofLength}$, making $r$ possible queries. For a seed of $V$ and a Boolean answer at each of the $r$ positions, define the local transcript to record that answer wherever the tester queries an address, and to record no answer where it makes no query.
